events.title: Fixed a Progression Issue
events.summary: In the INORIGAMI HACK DOWN demo, an issue occurred where the game would stop progressing after the conversation at the very beginning. We have identified the cause, applied a fix, and released an updated version today. The game can now be progressed normally.If you continue to experience this issue even after the update, please try uninstalling and reinstalling the game.We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

events.title: "INORIGAMI HACK DOWN" Derivative Works and Streaming Guidelines
events.summary: Thank you very much for your interest in INORIGAMI HACK DOWN. I am the game creator, Kazuhiro Tanaka.
